<thought>Since the forward cycloaddition loses a ketone and a C‑C triple bond, the retrosynthetic step must *form* those groups. The template search with “functional_groups_formed” returned no results, likely because the database indexes the groups that are *broken* in the forward direction. Therefore I will search for templates where the forward reaction breaks “ketones” and “C‑C triple bonds”. This should yield a suitable single‑step retrosynthetic transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": null,
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
